newsitem.title: USA: Former U.S. "first dog" Millie Bush dead.
newsitem.headline: Former U.S. "first dog" Millie Bush dead.

text.p: Former "first dog" Millie Bush, who is officially credited with penning a dog's-eye view of the presidency, has died, a spokeswoman for the former president George Bush said on Tuesday.
The springer spaniel died Monday at age 12 after taking ill with stomach problems at George and Barbara Bush's oceanside summer estate in Kennebunkport, a family spokeswoman said.
"They are very sad," Jean Becker told Reuters.

"Millie's Book," ostensibly dictated by Millie to Barbara Bush in 1990 with pictures of the dog posing with the political high and mighty raised $900,000 for the Barbara Bush Foundation for Family Literacy.
Millie's personal life also splashed into the headlines in March 1990, when she gave birth to four puppies at the White House. The family kept one of the offspring, Ranger, who died in 1993.

Millie was named after Mildred Kerr, a longtime friend and neighbour of the Bush family in Houston. The dog was given to the Bushes in 1987 when Millie was one year old, according to newspaper reports.
